integrations_researched.name: flutter_riverpod

key_functions: StateNotifier<T> - base class for state management
state = newState - updates state and notifies listeners
ref.watch(provider) - watch provider and rebuild on changes

undo_redo_approach.description: Riverpod doesn't have built-in undo/redo. Implement by maintaining a history list of previous states within a StateNotifier and adding undo()/redo() methods.

implementation_example.undo_method: Move current state to _future, pop from _history
implementation_example.redo_method: Move current state to _history, pop from _future

gotchas: StateNotifier is now legacy in Riverpod 3.0, but still supported
Project uses StateNotifier pattern - can continue using it or migrate to Notifier
Must ensure immutable state objects for proper undo/redo
Large state objects may consume significant memory in history stack

integrations_researched.name: undo

key_classes: ChangeStack - Stores and manages changes with undo/redo
Change - Represents a single undoable action with execute and revert callbacks
SimpleStack<T> - Generic state container with built-in undo/redo
key_functions: changes.add(Change(oldValue, execute, undo)) - Add a new undoable change
changes.canUndo - Boolean property for UI state
changes.canRedo - Boolean property for UI state

usage_example.description: Create a Change with initial value, execute function, and undo function

gotchas: When adding a change, it automatically calls execute() - be aware if action already executed
Need to pass the old value to properly revert state
For complex state, consider using SimpleStack with state snapshots

integrations_researched.name: async (CancelableOperation)

key_classes: CancelableOperation<T> - An async operation that can be cancelled
CancelableCompleter<T> - Creates a cancelable operation with manual control
key_functions: CancelableOperation.fromFuture(future, onCancel: callback) - Wrap a Future
operation.value - The Future result (won't complete if cancelled)
operation.isCanceled - Check if operation was cancelled
operation.valueOrCancellation(defaultValue) - Get value or default if cancelled

usage_example.code:
final operation = CancelableOperation.fromFuture(exportAll(), onCancel: () => cleanup());
// Later: operation.cancel();
usage_example.description: Wrap async export operation to make it cancellable

limitations: Does NOT truly stop the underlying Future - only cancels listening for result
If export writes files, cancellation won't undo partial writes
Need additional logic to check isCanceled during long operations
gotchas: Cancellation only prevents completion callbacks from firing
For file operations, should implement periodic cancellation checks
Consider cleanup of partial files on cancellation

limitations: Designed primarily for text input fields (TextField)
